subject.title: fix: PowerShell completion loses short flags and nested commands

question: Should a maintainer approve this focused PowerShell completion repair after its branch is refreshed against current `main` and required checks complete?
rationale: The change is a user-facing CLI repair with substantial supplied proof, but the repository’s protected `maintainer` label requires an explicit human merge decision.

options.title: Refresh and merge
options.body: Rebase the focused repair, confirm the required checks and PowerShell proof still apply to the new head, then merge.

options.title: Request a targeted follow-up
options.body: Keep the PR open only if a maintainer identifies a concrete completion-contract concern after reviewing the refreshed generated script.

recommendation.title: Refresh and merge
recommendation.body: Rebase the focused repair, confirm the required checks and PowerShell proof still apply to the new head, then merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The current PR author supplied the repair and direct PowerShell proof; a repository maintainer can make the final protected-label decision.
